$comment: TRANSCRIBED from plugins/synced_stereo/synced_stereo_keys.h + _io.h. synced_stereo is a GATHERING SOURCE: no process() input Record, its surface is CONFIG (fps settable; pack_mode opt-in; running/ticks read-only get_def), COMMANDS (start/stop/set_fps/fire), and a two-image FRAME (left+right under one trigger). The Frame extractor's derived has_both() convenience and the defaulted fire(int n = 1) are outside what the generator emits, so this decl sets "handwritten_io": true — the generator owns the KEY contract (_keys.gen.h) and the PackSchema (_schema.gen.h, slots left+right+seq) but synced_stereo_io.h stays hand-written (codegen-gap note in docs/new_gen/08, contract/codegen/README.md). polaris2 wave-2 (docs/new_gen/10 Pack migration, gate P1): the plugin is now BILINGUAL — its default Record path still emits the two-image record literally (the host-mock test pins those wire literals), and an opt-in pack_mode gathers left+right+seq into ONE sealed xi.pack@1 Pack per trigger, compiled against kPackMode/kSeq/kLeft/kRight here.
